ja: 僕は料理は好きだけど、夕食の後の片付けはいつもすごく面倒に感じちゃうんだよね。
en: Although I enjoy cooking, I always find cleaning up after dinner a real hassle.
alternatives: I like cooking, but I always find cleaning up after dinner a real pain.
Even though I enjoy cooking, cleaning up after dinner always feels like a real chore to me.
point: 「〜を面倒に感じる」は find + 動名詞 + a hassle の語順

ja: 私が頭にくるのは、ルームメイトが流しに皿を置きっぱなしにすることじゃなくて、彼女がもう洗ったって言い張ることなんだ。
en: What drives me crazy isn't the dishes my roommate leaves in the sink but the way she insists she's already washed them.
alternatives: It's not the dishes my roommate leaves in the sink that bother me, but the way she insists she's already washed them.
What gets to me is not that my roommate leaves dishes in the sink, but that she insists she's already washed them.
point: 「頭にくるのは A じゃなくて B」は What drives me crazy isn't A but B

ja: 弟はもう自分でシャツにアイロンをかけられるよ。
en: My brother can iron his own shirts now.
alternatives: My brother can iron his shirts by himself now.
My little brother can iron his own shirts now.
point: can の後ろは動詞の原形で irons にしない

ja: 洗濯機が止まったら、シャツを干しておいてくれる？
en: When the washing machine stops, can you hang the shirts up to dry?
alternatives: Can you hang the shirts out to dry when the washer stops?
Could you hang the shirts up to dry once the washing machine's done?
point: when 節は未来のことでも現在形 stops のまま

ja: 今週末、ガレージの片付けを手伝ってもらえないかなと思ってたんだけど。
en: I was wondering if you could help me clean out the garage this weekend.
alternatives: Would you mind helping me clean out the garage this weekend?
I was hoping you could help me clean out the garage this weekend.
point: I was wondering if you could で柔らかくお願いする

ja: お父さんは週末までに網戸を直すって言ってたけど、まだ手もつけてないよ。
en: Dad said he'd fix the window screen by the weekend, but he hasn't even started on it yet.
alternatives: Dad said he would fix the screen by the weekend, but he hasn't even touched it yet.
Dad told us he'd repair the window screen by the weekend, but he still hasn't started on it.
point: 言ってた内容は時制の一致で will ではなく would にする

ja: ごめん、僕は一番上の棚に手が届かないんだ。
en: Sorry, I can't reach the top shelf.
alternatives: Sorry, I can't get to the top shelf.
Sorry, the top shelf is too high for me.
point: 一番上の棚は特定の棚なので the top shelf と the をつける

ja: 疲れてても、寝る前にせめて自分のお椀はすすいでもらえる？
en: Even if you're tired, could you at least rinse your bowl before you go to bed?
alternatives: Even when you're tired, could you at least rinse out your bowl before bed?
Even if you're exhausted, can you at least rinse your bowl before going to bed?
point: 「〜てても」は even if、「せめて」の at least を落とさない

ja: エアコンのフィルター、先月から掃除されてないよ。
en: The air conditioner filter hasn't been cleaned since last month.
alternatives: Nobody has cleaned the air conditioner filter since last month.
The AC filter hasn't been cleaned since last month.
point: since があるので現在完了の受動 hasn't been cleaned

ja: もっと早く配管屋さんに電話してたら、うちは週末ずっとお湯なしで過ごさずに済んだのにね。
en: If we'd called the plumber earlier, we wouldn't have spent the whole weekend without hot water.
alternatives: If we had called a plumber sooner, we wouldn't have gone the whole weekend without hot water.
If we'd gotten the plumber in earlier, we wouldn't have been without hot water all weekend.
point: 過去の仮定は if 節が had + 過去分詞、主節は wouldn't have

ja: 今日私がやらなきゃいけないのは、洗濯物をたたむことだよ。
en: What I have to do today is fold the laundry.
alternatives: What I need to do today is fold the laundry.
The thing I have to do today is fold the laundry.
point: What I have to do is の後は動詞の原形で OK

ja: お母さんから電話があったとき、私はお風呂を掃除してたんだ。
en: I was cleaning the bathroom when Mom called.
alternatives: When Mom called, I was cleaning the bathroom.
I was cleaning the bathtub when Mom called me.
point: 途中だった動作は過去進行形 was cleaning で言う

ja: リビングのエアコンは先週の土曜に業者さんにクリーニングしてもらったから、フィルターは触らなくていいよ。
en: The living room AC was professionally cleaned last Saturday, so you don't need to touch the filter.
alternatives: We had the living room AC professionally cleaned last Saturday, so you don't need to touch the filter.
The living room AC got cleaned by a professional last Saturday, so there's no need to touch the filter.
point: エアコンを主語にするなら was cleaned と受け身にする

ja: お母さん、冷蔵庫に牛乳がもうないよ。
en: Mom, there's no milk in the fridge.
alternatives: Mom, there isn't any milk in the fridge.
Mom, we're out of milk.
point: milk は数えられないので a をつけず no milk とする

ja: 先月ルームメイトが食洗機を買うのに賛成してくれてたら、今ごろ私たち手で皿を洗ってないのにね。
en: If my roommate had agreed to buy a dishwasher last month, we wouldn't be washing dishes by hand now.
alternatives: If my roommate had agreed to get a dishwasher last month, we wouldn't be doing the dishes by hand right now.
If my roommate had said yes to buying a dishwasher last month, we wouldn't be washing the dishes by hand now.
point: 過去の仮定は had agreed、今の結果は wouldn't be 〜ing

ja: 冷蔵庫に入ってる牛乳、もう賞味期限が切れてるよ。
en: The milk in the fridge has already expired.
alternatives: The milk in the fridge is already past its expiration date.
The milk in the refrigerator has already expired.
point: 「冷蔵庫の牛乳」は in the fridge を milk の後ろに置く

ja: 兄は先週の日曜の午後ずっと庭にいて、草むしりをしたり落ち葉をかき集めたりしてたよ。
en: My older brother spent all of last Sunday afternoon in the yard, pulling weeds and raking leaves.
alternatives: My older brother was in the yard all last Sunday afternoon, pulling weeds and raking up leaves.
My older brother spent the whole afternoon last Sunday in the yard pulling weeds and raking leaves.
point: 「〜しながら過ごした」は spent + 時間 + -ing の形

ja: 今度の土曜日、僕たちはガレージを掃除するつもりだよ。
en: We're going to clean the garage this Saturday.
alternatives: We're going to clean out the garage this Saturday.
We're cleaning the garage this Saturday.
We plan to clean the garage this Saturday.
point: 前から決めている予定は be going to

ja: お母さん、弟に部屋を片付けるように言ってくれる？
en: Mom, can you tell my brother to clean his room?
alternatives: Mom, could you tell my brother to clean his room?
Mom, can you tell my brother to tidy up his room?
Mom, will you tell my brother to clean up his room?
point: tell + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: うちでは、子どもたちにゲームをする前に自分の部屋を片付けさせてるんだ。
en: We make the kids tidy up their rooms before they can play video games.
alternatives: We have the kids clean their rooms before they're allowed to play video games.
We get the kids to tidy their rooms before they play video games.
point: make + 人 + 動詞の原形。to は付けない

ja: 夫はゴミを出すのを忘れてたけど、もう出してくれたよ。
en: My husband forgot to take out the trash, but he's done it now.
alternatives: My husband forgot to take the trash out, but he's done it now.
My husband forgot to take out the garbage, but he's already done it.
point: 忘れたのは過去形、今は済んだ状態なので現在完了

ja: ねえ、掃除機がどこにあるか知ってる？
en: Do you know where the vacuum cleaner is?
alternatives: Do you happen to know where the vacuum is?
Any idea where the vacuum cleaner is?
point: 間接疑問は where the vacuum cleaner is の語順

ja: 掃除機、階段の横に置きっぱなしにしないで、いつもしまってるクローゼットに戻してくれる？
en: Could you put the vacuum back in the closet where we usually keep it instead of leaving it by the stairs?
alternatives: Can you put the vacuum back in the closet where it usually goes instead of leaving it next to the stairs?
Instead of leaving the vacuum by the stairs, could you put it back in the closet where we normally keep it?
point: 「いつもしまってる」場所は where we usually keep it と where で続ける

ja: ねえお父さん、ガレージを片付けるって、もう3週間ずっと言ってるよね。
en: Dad, you've been saying you'll clean out the garage for three weeks now.
alternatives: Dad, you've been promising to clean out the garage for three weeks now.
Dad, you've been telling us you'll clear out the garage for three weeks now.
point: 今も続く「ずっと言ってる」は have been saying、for で期間

ja: 今朝、洗濯物を外に干す前に、天気予報をちゃんと確認しておけばよかったなあ。
en: I wish I'd checked the forecast before hanging the laundry outside this morning.
alternatives: I wish I had looked at the weather forecast before I hung the laundry out this morning.
If only I'd checked the forecast before putting the laundry out to dry this morning.
point: 過去の後悔は wish の後を過去完了 I'd checked にする

ja: 姉はさっき洗剤を買いにスーパーへ行ったよ。
en: My sister just went to the supermarket to buy detergent.
alternatives: My sister went to the supermarket a little while ago to buy detergent.
My sister just went to the store to buy detergent.
My sister just went to the supermarket to get detergent.
point: 目的の「〜しに」は to + 動詞の原形で表す

ja: 出かける前に、リサイクルのゴミを出してもらってもいい？
en: Do you mind taking out the recycling before you leave?
alternatives: Would you mind taking out the recycling before you go?
Could you take out the recycling before you leave?
point: mind の後は動名詞。to take にしない
